cohort: Two children diagnosed with Transient Infantile Hypertriglyceridemia (TIH) from the indigenous Hindu, hilly population of Himachal Pradesh in North India.
finding: Transient infantile hypertriglyceridemia (TIH) can cause massive hepatosplenomegaly with fibrosis in children, and the study identified two cases in a previously unreported population group (indigenous Hindu, hilly population of Himachal Pradesh, North India) without a history of consanguinity or family history.
